text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Kita! ♪ You've never<n>missed my
birthday ever since we<n>were little.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, shall we continue our<n>yearly tradition
of celebrating at my<n>place?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, as always, thanks for the<n>invitation!
Birthday parties at your<n>estate always get me fired
up—they're like festivals!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. And Mother and Father<n>are looking
forward to hearing you<n>sing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So much so that they might even ask<n>you to
perform from the stage in our<n>garden—the one for
special events.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I'm glad to hear that, but<n>remember what
your father said last<n>time?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Would you like to record an official<n>theme song for
the Satono Group?" I<n>thought I was going to jump
out of<n>my skin!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. He was rather enthusiastic,<n>wasn't he?
Your singing must've<n>really moved him.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But now that you've come to the<n>academy and
performed on a real<n>stage, why not consider it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: H-hang on! It's your birthday party.How did we get to talking about me?!
